title: [Master Data Management] Avoid duplicate excluded record insertion after match-based coupling
summary: Master Data Management's match-based coupling now handles records excluded by the local table filter correctly by logging an error instead of attempting duplicate creation, preventing misleading insertion failures.
key_points: If no match is found inside the local filter, match-based coupling repeats the lookup without it, then logs an error pointing to the excluded record instead of coupling it or queuing it for creation
On the Synchronization Tables page, the Table Filter column is renamed Local Table Filter and is always visible
Fixed a latent crash on the no-match path when the source and local tables differ
Text matching values that contain filter characters such as * or ? now keep only exact case-insensitive matches
Telemetry event 0000J8E gets a new MatchExcludedByLocalTableFilter dimension
quote: If that finds a record, the source record is neither coupled nor queued for creation.
